Common data for Q.15 to 17: 
 
A binary transmission system with transmitted power 
Pt = 200 mW, attenuation L = 90 dB, and noise power 
spectral density N0 = 10–15 W/Hz is to have bit error 
probability Pe ≤ 10–4  
 
15. If noncoherent FSK is used, then the maximum 
allowable bit rate is 
 
(a) 
8.5 kbps 
(b) 10.1 kbps 
 
(c) 
11.7 kbps 
(d) none of these  
 
16. What will be the maximum allowable bit rate, if DPSK 
signaling scheme is used? 
 
(a) 
11.7 kbps 
(b) 23.5 kbps 
 
(c) 
8.5 kbps 
(d) None of these
